name: v2.8.128-beta.178
body:
## 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.128 (Build 178) - Public Beta

### What's New in this Release:
1. **Real Automated Accessibility Force-Stop Engine**:
   - Replaced passive background process signals with genuine automated Android Settings force-stopping via `PrivacyWindowService`.
   - When Accessibility Service is granted, 8002 CleanUp Pro systematically visits each selected app's Settings page, detects the native "Force stop" button (`com.android.settings:id/button2`, localized text), clicks it, and confirms the prompt, genuinely halting background memory execution.
   - If Shizuku or Root is authorized, executes silent instantaneous `am force-stop` without opening Settings screens.

2. **Accurate Active Process & Memory Inspection**:
   - Eliminated artificial bulk-listing of all installed applications. Now exclusively detects genuinely active applications in RAM (active within the last 4 hours in `UsageStatsManager`, or with active background services).
   - Apps marked as stopped by Android (`FLAG_STOPPED`) or stopped during the session are excluded from the running list, preventing stopped apps from immediately reappearing.
   - Stopped apps are removed from view and freed memory is immediately reflected on the RAM gauge.
   - Added manual full-cache refresh via the top-right refresh button.

3. **Quality, Accessibility & Testing**:
   - All light theme UI elements (`html.theme-light`) satisfy WCAG contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.
   - All 300 unit tests passing with 0 failures.
   - Direct build-to-publish execution compliant with user policy (zero Android emulators).

## 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.126 (Build 176) - Public Beta

### What's New in this Release:
1. **Compact, Zero-Overlap Top Navigation Panel ("Clean Unified Top Bar")**:
   - Replaced fragmented, overlapping absolute top layers with a streamlined, frosted glass `.famous-places-top-panel` (`backdrop-filter: blur(10px)`).
   - Unified Header Row:
     - Back navigation, clean app title (`3D Compass Places`), dynamic heading readout (`NW 295°`), and action buttons (`Layers`, `Camera AR`, `Location GPS`, `Information`).
   - Category Scope Tabs (`⭐ All`, `🕋 Holy`, `🇵🇰 Pakistan`, `🌍 World`) and Pakistan City Tabs (`All`, `Lahore`, `Karachi`, etc.) now flow naturally inside the top panel with zero overlapping or text clipping.
   - Steer Guidance Banner redesigned into a compact 30px floating pill (`[Arrow] Turn XX° · Landmark (Distance) [Details]`) that only appears when the target is off-screen, freeing up camera viewport space.

2. **360° Circular Radar Docked to Floating Lower-Right HUD**:
   - Moved the 360° Circular Radar completely out of the top navigation bar.
   - Now cleanly docked as a high-tech floating mini-radar in the lower right (`bottom: 130px; right: 14px;`), completely eliminating overlap with category and city tabs.

3. **Smart Anti-Collision Stacking Algorithm for AR Pins ("No Overlapping Pins")**:
   - When multiple landmarks share similar compass bearings (e.g. Gurdwara Janam Asthan in Nankana Sahib and Quaid-e-Azam Residency in Quetta from Lahore at ~260° WSW), pins are dynamically separated into vertical tiers (`offsetY = ±32px, ±64px`).
   - Vertical glowing laser stems dynamically stretch from each elevated capsule directly down to its exact horizon coordinate.
   - Every pin remains 100% visible, legible, and unblocked.

4. **100% Responsive Tap & Place Opening ("One-Tap Modal Dossier")**:
   - Expanded touch hitbox (`::before` with -10px padding, min 44x44px touch area) and added `onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}` to prevent touch events from being absorbed by background canvas dragging.
   - Tapping ANY landmark micro-pin or AR card brings it to the top (`z-index: 100`) and immediately opens the full Place Details Dossier modal.
   - Tapping ANY landmark in the bottom horizontal carousel ribbon (`.famous-places-chips-scroll`) now directly focuses the compass, highlights the target, and opens the Place Details Modal.
   - Tapping the floating Steer Pill or its `Details` button directly opens the Place Details Modal.

5. **Quality, Accessibility & Testing**:
   - All light theme UI elements (`html.theme-light`) strictly satisfy WCAG contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.
   - All 300 unit tests passing with 0 failures.
   - Direct build-to-publish execution compliant with user policy (zero Android emulators).

name: 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.123 (Build 173)
body:
## 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.123 (Build 173) - Public Beta

### What's New in this Release:
1. **Video Recorder Pro - Camera2 Recording & Seamless Playback Engine**:
   - **Fixed Video Recording Failure**: Resolved the headless Camera2 capture session issue where a detached SurfaceTexture caused `onConfigureFailed` on Android devices (ColorOS, OxygenOS, MIUI, OneUI). Recording now cleanly streams to MediaRecorder's native surface.
   - **Fixed Blank / Black Playback**: Resolved WebView origin security restrictions where local file paths (`/storage/emulated/0/...`) could not be decoded by `<video src="...">`. Implemented `Capacitor.convertFileSrc` streaming bridge for immediate in-app video and image playback.
   - **Integrated System Video Player Bridge**: Added a 1-tap "System Player" button in the preview modal calling `RecorderPlugin.openVideoInExternalPlayer` with Android `ACTION_VIEW` and `FileProvider` so users can watch recordings with hardware acceleration in VLC, MX Player, Google Photos, or system video players.
   - **Codec Error Fallback**: Added automatic playback fallback detection in the video viewer offering an instant button to launch the hardware decoder player if WebView cannot decode the stream.
   - **Multi-Directory Storage Discovery**: Enhanced `listRecordings` to scan public movies, app-specific movies, and internal storage, purging invalid 0-byte files so only real playable recordings are displayed.
   - **Automatic Runtime Permission Requests**: Added `requestRecorderPermissions` bridge ensuring Camera and Microphone permissions are automatically prompted and granted before starting recording.
   - **Safe MediaRecorder Stop Protection**: Ensured a minimum safe recording duration before stopping to prevent Android encoder `stop failed` exceptions and MP4 moov atom corruption.

2. **Quality & UI Invariants**:
   - Full light theme contrast support (`html.theme-light`) maintaining WCAG >= 4.5:1.
   - All 299 unit tests passing with 0 failures.
   - Preserves 103 active tool catalog invariant.

## 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.121 (Build 171) - Public Beta

### What's New in this Release:
1. **Video Recorder Pro - Stealth Security & Disguised Notifications**:
   - **Disguised Guard Notification Mode (`stealth`)**: Disguises the ongoing foreground recording notification as an innocent `"System Performance Guard"` ("Monitoring battery health and background resource allocation") with subtext `"Android System"` and a discrete action `"Optimize System"` that silently stops recording without alerting onlookers or screen peekers.
   - **Silent Notification Channel**: Utilizes low-priority silent notification channel (`IMPORTANCE_MIN`) with zero sound, zero vibration, zero lights, and no notification badge.
   - **Configurable Privacy Modes**: Switch effortlessly between `[Disguised Guard 🛡️]`, `[Discreet 🤫]`, and `[Standard 🔔]` notification levels.

2. **Automatic Gallery Shield (`.nomedia`)**:
   - **Hide From Phone Gallery**: Dedicated one-tap `.nomedia` shield toggle in the header and console that shields all recorded clips and snapshots from appearing in Samsung Gallery, Google Photos, WhatsApp media pickers, and file explorers.
   - **Direct-to-Hidden / Direct-to-Vault Recording**: Configure recording target directly to `[🔒 Secret Vault]`, `[🛡️ Hidden Folder]`, or `[🖼️ Public Gallery]`.

3. **Encrypted Secret Vault (`App Locker / Vault`) Integration**:
   - **AES-XOR Encrypted Storage**: Secure 256-bit symmetric encryption immediately scrambles recorded videos and secret photo snapshots into `.vault` format inside private app storage.
   - **PIN & Fingerprint Biometric Authentication**: Built-in master security lock protecting vault contents from unauthorized users.
   - **Decrypted In-App Secure Playback & Image Viewer**: Watch videos or view snapshots directly within the encrypted session without leaking decrypted plaintext to device storage.
   - **Vault Item Management**: One-tap `Move to Secret Vault`, `Export Back to Gallery`, or permanent cryptographic file deletion.
   - **Headless Secret Snapshot (`📸`)**: Instantly capture silent high-resolution JPEG photos directly to the encrypted vault.

4. **UI & Quality Invariants**:
   - Full dark mode glassmorphism UI with active tab selector (`Local Clips` vs `Secret Vault`).

body:
### 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.119 (Build 169) - Public Beta

#### What's New & Improvements:

• **Voice Recorder Pro (Background & Screen-Off Audio Recording)**:
  • Runs silently as a low-power background foreground service (`StealthAudioService`) backed by CPU partial wake locks.
  • Screen-off support: Continues recording seamlessly even when the phone screen is turned off or while multitasking in other apps.
  • Minimal notification noise: Operates with a discreet, low-priority ongoing notification and direct "Stop" action button.
  • High-fidelity 128 kbps AAC audio capture at 44.1 kHz saved to `Music/8002_Recordings/`.
  • Audio memo studio with real-time waveform bars, in-app playback, file metadata, delete confirmation, and instant sharing.

• **Video Recorder Pro (Hidden Background Video with Camera & Audio Controls)**:
  • Background headless video capture utilizing Android Camera2 API and MediaRecorder (`StealthVideoService`).
  • **Camera Selection**: Toggle seamlessly between Back Camera and Front Camera.
  • **Resolution Controls**: Choose between 480p (Space Saver), 720p (HD Balanced), and 1080p (Full HD).
  • **Microphone Toggle**: Choose Mic On or Mic Off (Silent/Muted video recording).
  • **Storage Overflow Guard**: Lightweight ongoing notification displays live duration and a quick "Stop" button so users always know background recording is active and storage is never unexpectedly exhausted.
  • In-app video preview player modal, file metadata, delete, and sharing support.

• **Catalog & Dashboard**:
  • Total Home tools catalog expanded from 100 to 102 tools.
  • Colorful 3D icons assigned for both new tools (`mic.png` and `video-cam.png`).
  • Full WCAG >= 4.5:1 contrast compliance in Light Theme (`html.theme-light`).
  • All 288 test suites passing cleanly.

# 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.96 (Build 145)

### Highlights & Key Improvements
1. **1Tap Cleaner Pro Direct Navigation Fix**:
   - Resolved routing issue where clicking 1Tap Cleaner previously fell back to Tools Hub.
   - Now directly opens the Cache Cleaner screen with detailed cache breakdown, SD storage scanner, and 1-tap FAB broom.
2. **WhatsApp Recover & Status Pro Contact Attribution**:
   - Status cards now prominently display the contact/username directly on the status card.
   - Added interactive Contact Stories carousel at the top of the Statuses tab for quick 1-tap filtering.
   - Compact forensics bar replacing bulky telemetry headers to save vertical screen space.
3. **Direct WhatsApp Chat Dual-SIM / Multi-Account Selector**:
   - Added sender app switcher: Choose between WhatsApp (Personal / SIM 1) or WhatsApp Business (SIM 2).
   - Clarified recipient phone number input with international country selector and pre-filled message support.
   - Added transparent cryptographic security notice explaining Signal protocol end-to-end device binding.
4. **Verified Cryptographic Signature**:
   - APK signed with continuous SHA-256: `92cbdb92ec298f841523d065fb0008d455fc823a1f72054602af47d15c740706`.

name: 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.94 (Build 143) · Framing & Responsive Recalibration
body:
## 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.94 (Build 143) · Typography, Safe-Area & Framing In-Depth Recalibration

### 🚀 Highlights & Major Updates:

#### 1. 🔥 Fresh Releases & Quick Test Section (Precision Responsive Framing)
- **Compact & Consistent Test Triggers**: Standardized all quick-launch triggers to `[⚡ Test Now]`, eliminating awkward text wrapping or `[⚡ Test No` cutoff on compact displays.
- **Strict Viewport Containment**: Added `overflow: hidden; box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 100%` with CSS 2-line clamp (`-webkit-line-clamp: 2`) on descriptions to ensure test cards fit flush on all screen widths.
- **Auto-Truncating Badges**: Tags, dates, and titles now feature strict `text-overflow: ellipsis` safeguards against layout blowouts.

#### 2. 🧹 1Tap Cleaner Pro (Notch & Navigation Bar Safe-Area Calibration)
- **Top Safe-Area Offset**: Integrated `padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)` so hardware camera punch-holes and dynamic island notches do not occlude the top header icons (Menu, APPS count, Search, Sort, Filter, Pro, Close).
- **Responsive Action Buttons**: Scaled icon buttons to 6px padding with 4px gap so all 5 header actions remain 100% in-frame on 360px Android devices.
- **App Storage 4-Column Grid Calibration**: Added `min-width: 0`, `white-space: nowrap`, and `text-overflow: ellipsis` on all metric columns (`Cache`, `Data`, `Code`, `Total`), ensuring storage values like `199.87 MB` never overflow or force card distortion.
- **Bottom Status Bar & FAB Broom Clearance**: Padded the bottom storage gauge and floating green broom with `env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)` to provide full clearance above the Android system gesture bar.

#### 3. ⚡ 8002 App Killer Pro (RAM Gauge & Tabs Responsive Balancing)
- **Tab Header Overhaul**: Shortened tab names to `Killable ({count})`, `Whitelisted ({count})`, and `System` with `text-overflow: ellipsis`, preventing the tabs bar from wrapping or pushing tabs out of screen.
- **RAM Telemetry Gauge Scaling**: Compacted circular RAM gauge from 90px to 76px with 20px typography and tightened stat rows to fit narrow phone viewports comfortably.
- **Safe-Area Padding**: Added top and bottom edge-to-edge safe area offsets.

#### 4. 💬 WhatsApp Recover & Status Pro (Horizontal Tab & Header Balance)
- **Tab Label Truncation**: Refactored tab labels to `Deleted Chats`, `Status Saver`, and `Direct Chat` with badge overflow protection.
- **Header Font Normalization**: Tuned title typography to `1.02rem` with ellipsis handling to eliminate header clipping.

#### 5. 📥 EX Downloader Pro (Target Selector Streamlining)
- **Streamlined Storage Target Selector**: Replaced long verbose destination text with clean labels `Local Drive` and `🔒 Secret Vault` with responsive wrapping protection.
- **Tab Buttons Ellipsis**: Public Downloads vs Secret Vault tabs now maintain strict truncation.

#### 6. 🔒 Continuous Security & Integrity Gate
- Continuous Signing Key SHA-256: `92cbdb92ec298f841523d065fb0008d455fc823a1f72054602af47d15c740706` verified.
- Play Store policy compliance: No `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` in release bundle.
- 189 unit and integration test suites passing with 100% success.
- Includes universal Release APK (`8002CleanUp-v2.8.94-release.apk`) and Play Store Bundle (`8002CleanUp-v2.8.94-release.aab`).
